front: What is the **income statement** (statement of profit or loss)?
back: A statement of revenue, cost of sales, gross profit, other income, expenses and profit (or loss) for a period.
Opening inventory + purchases + carriage inwards − purchases returns − closing inventory.

front: Where does carriage inwards go? Carriage outwards?
back: Carriage inwards: added to purchases (cost of sales). Carriage outwards: an expense.
Discount received: other income (added). Discount allowed: an expense (deducted).
Always the OPENING inventory. Closing inventory is given as a note.

front: Why does a service business have no gross profit?
back: It sells services, not goods, so there is no cost of sales; it starts with fees and deducts expenses.
